notes: Landscape sheet (1978 edition, SHEET 5). A single heavy frame rule (~10 px top/bottom, ~30 px left with a slightly speckled inner band, ~12 px right) on all four sides; the outline sits ~1.5 px inside each rule's inner edge (README rule 1). Each side's inner edge was measured column/row by column/row, median+mean smoothed and simplified (points every <=350 px); corners where the fitted sides meet. No corner arcs, no notches: the title (ZONING MAP OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO) is printed above the frame and the legend, code note, north arrow, scale and SHEET 5 number stand in the margin left of the frame, all outside it. Nothing to remove inside the frame (no compass, SECTION badge or legend block). The grey scan smudges in the blank paper between the left rule and the map (x ~860-1050, y ~1900-2300) are inside, as blank paper inside the frame. PACIFIC OCEAN, GOLDEN GATE PARK and district codes are map. Ink under the outline: only 1-2 px nubs on the rules' inner edges and the rule's inner fillet at the top-right corner.
drawn_by: Claude (R2 training labels), rule inner edges measured column by column on page.png, median+mean smoothed, checked by eye on full-resolution crops, 2026-11-21
